source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The setup awaits the window delayed-startup promise before checking telemetry and enabling the test calendar. Messenger resolves that promise after its component loader; that loader awaits Calendar startup, which registers the deactivator. This pairs the test's readiness condition with the actual producer. It does not establish an executed intermittent-test cure, all lazy views being initialized or telemetry delivery.
title: The Calendar telemetry setup waits for startup before enabling its calendar
